signals.title: Revenue exceeds MRR by 25.9%
signals.detail: 28-day revenue ($6,022) is higher than MRR ($4,782). That usually means one-time purchases or annual upfront recognition are inflating cash above the recurring base.
signals.caveat: Compare the gap across multiple periods before making a pricing call.
signals.followup: Segment Revenue by product or store to identify the non-recurring contributor.

signals.title: New customers are 76% of active subs in 28d
signals.detail: 1,975 new customers arrived against a paid base of 2,605. Growth is healthy, but conversion to paying may still be leaving money on the table.
signals.followup: Check Conversion to Paying for the same window.
